name: tool-lens-mod
description: Plain-language, live view of what the agent is doing: a one-line band above the prompt that expands upward into the plan, tool calls and progress.

smartLabels.title: Plain-language step labels
smartLabels.description: Ask a small model to word skill, connected-app and shell steps in terms of your request (for example "Looking up your open CoBrain tasks"). Sends your request and the redacted step to the model, one short call per step. Off keeps the built-in wording.

requirePlan.title: Require a plan for multi-step tasks
requirePlan.description: Refuse the third tool call of a task that has not posted a plan, once, with a note asking for one. This is what makes the plan, the step count and the percent appear while the work happens and not after it. Off leaves it to the model.
